This directory contains the following open-licensed Chinese fonts,
all under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL):

- song.ttf: ZCOOL XiaoWei (站酷小薇), by ZCOOL
  Source: https://github.com/google/fonts (ofl/zcoolxiaowei)
  Used for the "宋体" (Songti) style.

- hei.ttf: ZCOOL QingKe HuangYou (站酷庆科黄油体), by ZCOOL
  Source: https://github.com/google/fonts (ofl/zcoolqingkehuangyou)
  Used for the "黑体" (Heiti) style.

- fangsong.ttf: Zhuque Fangsong (朱雀仿宋), by TrionesType
  Source: https://github.com/TrionesType/zhuque (v0.212)
  Used for the "仿宋" (Fangsong) style.

All three are licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1,
which permits embedding (including in PDFs), redistribution, and
modification. See https://openfontlicense.org for the full license text.
